title: Statement simulation
statement: Fix a word size $W$, a compiler setting $S$, a natural number $d$, a statement $s$, states $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$, and a natural number $c$. The statement $s$ is simulated from $\sigma$ to $\sigma'$ with parameters $d$ and $c$ if, for every code position $pos$, frame index $q$, and memory map $m : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{BitVec}(W)$ for which $\mathrm{Start}(S,d,s,\sigma,pos,q,m)$ holds, there are a memory map $m' : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathrm{BitVec}(W)$ and a natural number $n$ such that $\mathrm{Finished}(S,s,\sigma',c,pos,q,m,m',n)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number word size $W$ and compiler setting $S$

For every code position $pos$, frame index $q$, and word-valued memory map $m$, if the start predicate holds, there exist a word-valued memory map $m'$ and natural number $n$ for which the finished predicate holds
caveat: The payload does not define the predicates $\mathrm{Start}$ and $\mathrm{Finished}$, so their precise execution semantics cannot be stated from the provided information.
